_read_me: A/B tests. How to run and read one: docs/AB-TESTING.md.
Each visitor in a test is given one version at random, on their first view, and keeps it on later visits (stored in their browser). Nothing is stored for anyone outside a test.
id: short, lower case, letters, digits and dashes (it goes into analytics, so never rename a running test).
status: "off" (everyone sees the first version, nothing recorded), "running" (split and recorded), "ended" (everyone sees the winner, nothing recorded).
versions: name -> share, e.g. {"no-code": 50, "code": 50}. The FIRST is the control: what people outside the test see.
sources (optional): only visitors who arrived through these addresses join, e.g. ["golf"] for 513autoclean.com/golf. Leave it out for everyone.
winner: the version everyone gets once status is "ended".

On a page, an element shown for one version only:

...

. In code: window.AC_EXP("golf-code") returns the version.
Which version a booking saw is printed in the booking email and the calendar event, so bookings can be counted even when the visitor declined analytics.
A mistake in this file fails the build.
